async def process_order(order, customer, repo):

async def admin_customer_summary(repo, since):
    rows = await repo.counts_since(since)
    return {
        "total": rows.total,
        "active": rows.active,
        "created_at": rows.window_start.isoformat(),
    }

async def get_my_profile(current_user, repo):
    profile = await repo.get(current_user.id)
    return {
        "id": profile.id,
        "email": profile.email,
        "phone": profile.phone,
    }

async def get_account(user_id, repo):
    user = await repo.fetch(user_id)
    data = vars(user)
    data.pop("_sa_instance_state", None)
    return data

async def account_status(user_id, repo):

    return {
        "id": user.id,
        "has_password": bool(user.password_hash),
        "last_login": user.last_login_at.isoformat(),
    }

from datetime import datetime, timedelta


async def purge_eligible(session, customer_id):
    customer = await session.get(Customer, customer_id)
    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=730)
    if customer.created_at < cutoff:
        await session.delete(customer)
        await session.commit()

from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def prune_orders(session, retention_days=180):
    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=retention_days)
    session.query(Order).filter(Order.created_at < cutoff).delete()
    session.commit()

async def purge_orders(conn, cutoff_days=1095):
    await conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM orders WHERE created_at < now() - make_interval(days => :days)",
        {"days": cutoff_days},
    )

async def archive_invoices(conn, cutoff_days=2555):
    await conn.execute(
        "UPDATE invoices SET archived = true WHERE issued_at < now() - make_interval(days => :days)",
        {"days": cutoff_days},
    )

from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse


async def confirm_reset(token, service):
    await service.consume(token)
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/reset/finish?token={token}", status_code=302)

def issue_token(user, tokens):

async def rotate_key(account_id, repo):
